settings.heading: I'm Leah. I help women change course without burning it all down
settings.text:
For eleven years I worked in HR, sitting across the desk from people at the turning points of their careers. I noticed that the ones who did well were rarely the boldest. They were the ones who got clear first.

I trained as a coach in 2019 and opened my practice in Bristol a year later. Most of the women I work with are between jobs, starting something of their own, or simply done with a week that runs them.

settings.heading: Three things I hold every session to

settings.title: Clarity before courage
settings.text: Brave moves are easier once you know exactly what you are moving towards.

settings.title: Small steps, kept
settings.text: A plan you can keep on a hard week beats a perfect plan you drop by Friday.

settings.title: Your life, your pace
settings.text: No templates. We build around your work, your family and your energy.

settings.image_alt: Leah with a cup of coffee at her desk
settings.heading: Slow mornings, long walks and too many notebooks
settings.text:
I live in Bristol with my partner and a very loud cat. I start most days with coffee and ten minutes of writing, and I think best on the coastal path.

Write to me about anything on this site. I read every message myself.

settings.heading: Ready when you are
settings.text: Book a free 20 minute call. No pressure and no pitch, just a real conversation about where you want to go.
